findings.issue: Same as elsewhere: glossary bans السداسيّ الأرجل for Hexapod outside Merrick's mishearing gag; approved term is الهكسابود. This is Proxima speaking plainly, not the gag.

findings.source_en: I mean I don’t even know what this Hexa-thing is.
findings.ar: أعني، لا أعرف أصلًا ما هذا الشيء… السداسيّ ذاك.
findings.issue: This IS Merrick's mishearing gag ("Hexa-thing"), which per glossary must keep the stem الهكسا (e.g. hexa-dog -> الهكسا-كلب, correctly done elsewhere in this same chunk at TheExchange_S3_EnterMerrick_02/38A7630B...). Here the translation drops the stem entirely and uses السداسيّ ("the six- [legged] one"), breaking the running joke's mechanism.
findings.suggested_ar: أعني، لا أعرف أصلًا ما هذا الشيء… الهكسا ذاك.
